--Note: This is a new feature - please report any bugs to help the clan system improve! Many more features coming soon!


Other Changes and Improvements:
--Added auto mine!
-- Rebirth ticket cost reduced to 500 gems (gem drop amounts have been reduced)
--Made separate rebirth shop
--Improved performance and fixed UI bugs


Make sure to keep submitting any suggestions or bug reports! I read them all!
